summary: Iteration 19: verified the bio URL regex false-positive fix that was blocking users from completing onboarding at Paso 9. Backend regex now requires 3+ alphanum + dot + real TLD + word boundary. Added new test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration19_bio_regex.py with 15 tests (12 for validate_bio via PATCH /profile/me + 3 E2E via POST /profile/onboarding including the exact bug repro 'Vamos.como amigos'). All 15 pass. Frontend regex mirrors backend exactly (verified in browser via page.evaluate over 10 cases — 10/10 pass).
action_items: The user-reported production bug is fixed in preview. Safe to redeploy to plansobrio.com.

Demo users (demo1..demo12@plansobrio.cl) are NOT seeded in the current preview DB (only 1 admin user exists). This makes older regression suites (test_iteration10_ajustesv2.py, etc.) skip/fail with 401 login. Not a regression from this bug fix, but worth investigating: `demo_seed_enabled` may have been set to false by a prior admin wipe. Consider adding an admin `/api/admin/reseed-demos` endpoint or documenting the manual re-seed steps for testers.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend regex `\b[a-z0-9-]{3,}\.(?:com|cl|...)\b` and frontend `BIO_URL_RE` in Onboarding.jsx are duplicated string-for-string. Consider centralizing to a shared constant (e.g., src/lib/validation.js + backend/core/validators.py) with a small linter test that keeps them in sync — otherwise future TLD additions can drift.

www case: regex matches 'www.google' (stopping at the 3rd alternative branch on the '.com' portion). For 'www.google.com' this correctly rejects. But 'www.ab' would ALSO match the www branch (`\bwww\.[a-z0-9-]{2,}`) even without a TLD — likely acceptable since anything looking like 'www.something' is spammy, but flag if you want stricter matching.

The 'co' TLD is included in the reject list. This means 'busco.co sas' will now match (5 alphanum + .co + word boundary → reject). If users write phrases like 'gente que busco.co' that's unlikely, but 'busco.como' is safe (no boundary). Current implementation is a reasonable trade-off.
Missing GET /api/profile/me: only PATCH/DELETE exist for /profile/me. All reads go through /api/auth/me. Not a bug but worth noting; the old iteration10 tests used /profile/me and would 404.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 new tests pass; regex + PATCH + E2E onboarding all green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for regex mirror check (10/10 cases). Full multi-step UI walk not executed (auth-context rehydrate blocker); code-review confirmed data-testid='bio-error' wired at Onboarding.jsx L334 and canNext step 6 blocks on validateBioClient L80.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The bio regex false-positive bug (iteration 19) is fully verified fixed. If demo users need to be reseeded for older test suites, check core.seed_data and app_settings.demo_seed_enabled flag. Preview backend URL: https://comunidad-sobria.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend GET /api/profile/me does NOT exist — use GET /api/auth/me to read the current user profile.
rca of the issue: OLD regex `(https?://|www\.|\.com|\.cl|\.net|\.org|\.io|\.co\b)` matched the bare substring '.com' inside normal Spanish words (e.g., 'Vamos.como amigos'). NEW regex `(?:https?://[^\s]+|\bwww\.[a-z0-9-]{2,}|\b[a-z0-9-]{3,}\.(?:com|cl|net|org|io|co|app|es|ar|mx|pe|uy|xyz|info)\b)` requires 3+ alphanumeric chars before the dot AND a word boundary after the TLD, so only real domains match. Mitigation shipped: (1) backend server.py L257-262 updated regex, (2) frontend Onboarding.jsx L16 mirrored regex + validateBioClient added L19-26, (3) inline `data-testid='bio-error'` message at L334 gives feedback in step 6 (not step 9), (4) canNext() step 6 (L80) blocks Next button while error is present. All verified via backend integration tests + frontend regex evaluation. Repro of original bug (POST /profile/onboarding with bio='Vamos.como amigos') now returns 200 OK.
